query_analysis.original_query: Our vacuum distillation unit is showing signs of fouling. What predictive maintenance strategies can help mitigate long-term performance degradation?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate and recommend predictive maintenance strategies to mitigate fouling and prevent long-term performance degradation in a vacuum distillation unit.

selected_agents.role: Analyze fouling causes and recommend maintenance strategies

communication_strategy.information_flow: From root cause analysis to predictive model development and strategy implementation
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative development and validation of maintenance strategies

clarification_questions: What types of fouling are being observed in the vacuum distillation unit?
Have there been any recent changes in feedstock or operating conditions?
Do you have historical performance data and maintenance records for the unit?
